atoms.b:
Bei reported questions werden die Fragen in ((++Aussagen Ausrufe)) umformuliert, indem man if oder whether einfügt. Bei Wh-questions wird das ((++Fragewort Fragezeichen)) übernommen. Die Zeitform wird meist weiter in die ((++Vergangenheit Zukunft)) gerückt.

Beispiel:
((She_wondered_whether_I_had_showered. --She_said_I_looked_nice.))

Bei reported demands wird das Verb aus der Aufforderung in den ((++Infinitiv Singular)) gesetzt. Die wiedergegebene Aufforderung kann beispielsweise durch to advise oder to warn eingeleitet werden.

Beispiel:
((They_advised_me_to_save_my_money. --They_told_me_that_I_needed_more_money.))

instruction.text: Ordne den Fragen die richtigen reported questions zu.
instruction.sound: Ordne den Fragen die richtigen <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>reported questions</voice> zu

atoms.a: “What was your favourite moment of the last year?”
atoms.b: Ronda asked me what my favourite moment of the last year had been.
John wondered whether I was going to the party.
Oscar wanted to know where Clara bought her jacket.

atoms.a: “Have you finished your book report yet?”
atoms.b: The teacher asked if we had finished our book report yet.

instruction.text: Höre zu und wähle die richtige indirekte Wiedergabe der Frage oder Aufforderung aus.

hint.text: Du kannst dir den Satz noch einmal anhören, indem du auf den Lautsprecher tippst.

atoms.a: What's the coolest video game right now?
b: ++Gabor asked what the coolest video game was.
Gabor asked to play the coolest video game.

atoms.a: We would like you to buy more exciting books for the school library.
b: ++Felina told the headteacher to buy more exciting books for the school library.
Felina asked the headteacher what more exciting books for the school library would cost.

atoms.a: Would you like to have superpowers?
b: ++Keira asked if I would like to have superpowers.

atoms.a: You should plan a class trip to a theme park.
b: Ali asked his teacher whether he could plan a class trip to a theme park.
++Ali told his teacher to plan a class trip to a theme park.

instruction.text: Gib die Frage oder Aufforderung indirekt wieder, indem du den Satz bildest. Beginne mit dem Begleitsatz.

atoms.a: Karla asked: “Where do you want to live in the future?”
Namika said: “You should visit Loch Ness if you're ever in Scotland.”
